_doc: The chieftain's dilemmas, in the shared format run by story.gd (dilemma_view / dilemma_choose); see docs/CONFIG.md. A text is an English translation key, or [key, var names...] filled in order. Vars: speaker, pop, day, choice, fighters, chance_pct, plus those the rules supply (clan_name, chief, demand, festival...). Costs are numbers, var names or {per_pop: k}; cost_note false leaves the cost out of the description (it already says it). routine: {prefer: [option indexes]} marks a routine matter the Steward may decide.

flood.title: The Great Flood Warning
flood.speaker: best:lore
flood.text: %s wakes screaming: in the vision, black rains fall for nine nights and the river swallows the low camps. The elders look to you, Great Chieftain.

options.label: The Ark Plan
options.desc: Spend 40 wood on highland rafts and shelters. Everyone and everything is saved.

do.remember: built highland rafts on the Ark Plan before the Great Flood

options.result: Rafts are lashed and shelters raised on the highland. When the waters come, the tribe watches from safety.

options.label: Sacrifice to the River Deity
desc: Offer 25 food and relics. %d%% chance (scales with %s's Shamanism).

do.remember: appeased the River Deity and turned aside the Great Flood

options.result: The river deity accepts the offering. The rains pass the tribe by.
options.else_result: The deity is not appeased. The Great Flood strikes!

options.label: Trust the riverbanks
options.desc: Do nothing and hope the vision is false.
options.result: The tribe ignores the vision. Nine nights later, the river rises.

overpop.title: Overpopulation Crisis
text: The tribe now numbers %d. Game is thinning around the bonfire and quarrels break out over the last berries.

options.label: Frontier Colonization
options.desc: Appoint an experienced leader via a Task Contract to found a sister settlement on the frontier.
options.result: Choose a leader for the frontier. Their Task Contract negotiation begins now.

options.label: Territorial Conquest
options.desc: Rally your 3 best warriors to raid a rival tribe for food and timber. Risky.

do.remember: raided a rival tribe and returned victorious on Day %d

result: %s return victorious, hauling 60 food and 40 timber from the rival camp.

else_do.remember: was beaten back in a failed raid on a rival tribe on Day %d

else_result: The raid fails. %s limp home, bloodied and empty-handed.

chosen.title: Birth of the Chosen One
chosen.text: Under a sky split by lightning, a child is born bearing the mark of the totem. Which mythic bloodline awakens?
result: %s %s is born! The whole tribe feels the totem's favor.

era2.title: Dawn of the Tribe & Agrarian Era
text: New wisdom changes how the tribe lives, and not everyone is glad. %s

voices.warrior: "Digging in the dirt? We are hunters!"
voices.mystic: "The forest spirits will not forgive the axe and the flame."
voices.cautious: "Walls and stores - that is how a tribe lasts."
voices.lazy: "If the food grows by itself, I like it."

options.label: Put down roots
options.desc: Fields, pens and stores come first. (Settled +30, Spiritual -10)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

options.label: Honor the hunt
options.desc: The tribe stays hunters at heart. (Roaming +30, Martial +15)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

options.label: Let the shamans decide
options.desc: Ask the spirits before every change. (Spiritual +30, +15 lore)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

era3.title: Dawn of the Bronze & Mythic Era
text: Great works are now within reach, and the elders argue over what the tribe should become. %s

voices.warrior: "Arm every hand and no beast will trouble us again!"
voices.mystic: "Raise the great totems so the ancestors see us."
voices.cautious: "Laws, not spears, keep a people whole."

options.label: The Bronze Oath
options.desc: A warrior people under strong chiefs. (Martial +30, Ranked +15)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

options.label: The Totem Covenant
options.desc: A people of the spirits. (Spiritual +30, +20 devotion)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

options.label: The Elders' Law
options.desc: Rule by council and shared stores. (Ranked +20, Settled +15)

remember: lived through the dawn of the %s, when the tribe chose '%s'

result: The tribe chooses '%s'. The %s begins. Homes can now be rebuilt in the new style.

last_stand._doc: The last stand (make_it_fun E1): posed once when few are left (rules.json triggers.last_stand). Joining a clan ends the chronicle as the merged ending (legacy.json), not a defeat; it needs a clan that would take us in (legacy.refuge(): met, Friendly or better, or at peace). Vars: clan, clan_name, can_merge, pop.
last_stand.title: The Last Stand
text: Only %d of us are left. Around the fire the survivors ask what will become of the tribe.

options.label: We hold the fire
options.desc: We stay and fight on, however few. (Spirits rise; the chronicle goes on.)

do.remember: swore with the last of the tribe to hold the fire on Day %d

options.result: The survivors bank the fire high and swear to keep it burning.

options.label: We join our friends
desc: Walk to the fires of the %s and live on among them. (The chronicle ends here, not in defeat.)
result: The last of our people set out for the %s.
options.else_result: No clan would take us in. The survivors stay by the fire.

first_day._doc: The first day's fever (make_it_fun D2): posed once by rules.json triggers.first_day when the game starts with its opening (sim.opening); someone falls ill first. One pause that teaches a tradeoff, and the elder's remembered remedy (D1) is one answer. Vars: sick, sick_who, herb, elder.
first_day.title: Fever on the First Day
text: %s is burning with fever and cannot rise from the furs. %s says that long ago the cure was %s.

options.label: Search for the remedy
desc: Send a few out to look for %s. (A search contract: they may find more than the cure, but they are away from the work.)

options.label: Rest and broth by the fire
desc: Keep %s warm and well fed while the fever runs its course. (Costs 10 food; spirits rise.)
result: %s sleeps by the fire, wrapped in furs, with a bowl of broth beside them.

options.label: Every hand is needed
options.desc: No one can be spared from the work. (The sick rest alone; the tribe grumbles.)
options.result: The work goes on. Now and then someone looks over at the sick one in the furs.

autumn._doc: The autumn decision (make_it_fun B1): posed when autumn begins (hazards._autumn_begins), after the director has picked the coming winter's kind; the text quotes the elders' signs of it (var signs). Each option is a bet on a kind: the feast on a mild one, smoking meat on a lean one, firewood and stakes on a white or a wolf one, the hunt and the slaughter on food. Vars: signs, oxen, ox_meat, feast_cost, festival.
autumn.title: The Autumn Council
text: The leaves are turning. At the fire the elders read the signs of the winter to come: %s What will the tribe do before the cold?

options.label: Hold the Harvest Feast
desc: Eat well and dance while the berries last. Costs %d food. (Mood +25, and the glow of it lasts through the winter; devotion +5; friendly clans come.) A bet on a gentle winter.
options.result: Drums and fire until dusk: the tribe feasts before the cold.

options.label: Smoke and store the meat
options.desc: Build smoking racks and dry everything the stores hold. Costs 20 wood. (This winter stored food keeps far longer.) A bet on a lean winter.
options.result: Smoke hangs over the camp for days. The meat is dried and hung in the rafters.

options.label: Cut firewood and fence the camp
options.desc: Stack wood high, pack the walls with moss and hide, and ring the camp with stakes and fires. Costs 30 wood. (This winter the cold bites much less, and fewer wolf packs come near.) A bet on a hard white winter or a wolf winter.
options.result: Woodpiles rise beside every hut, the cracks in the walls are stuffed with moss, and stakes ring the camp.

options.label: Slaughter the oxen
desc: Kill the %d oxen now for %d food, rather than feed them through the winter. The pens will stand empty.
options.result: The oxen are slaughtered and their meat hung to dry. The pens are quiet.

options.label: Send the hunters out before the snow
options.desc: The best hunters go after the last fat game of the year. If they are lucky, 50 food; if not, they come back hurt.

do.remember: brought home the last great hunt of the autumn on Day %d

result: %s come home heavy with meat: 50 food for the winter.
else_result: The game is gone. %s come home cold, hurt and empty-handed.

0.name: Festival of Renewal
0.text: The first green shoots are up and the birds are back. The elders ask whether the tribe will hold the Festival of Renewal.

2.name: Harvest Festival
2.text: The berries are heavy and the herds are fat. The elders ask whether the tribe will hold the Harvest Festival before the cold.

3.name: Long Night Fire
3.text: Winter has come. The elders ask whether the tribe will light the Long Night Fire, to sing the sun back.

options.label: A great festival
desc: Feast, dance and drum around the bonfire. Costs %d food and an afternoon's work. (Mood +25, devotion +8, friendly clans come.)
result: Drums and fire until dusk: the %s is a night the tribe will remember.

options.label: A small gathering
desc: Songs at the fire. Costs %d food. (Mood +12, devotion +3)
options.result: The tribe gathers at the fire for songs and stories.

options.label: No festival this time
options.desc: Keep everyone working. (Mood -10, devotion -3)
options.result: No festival this time. The people work on, but their hearts are heavy.

routine._doc: A routine matter: with a Steward appointed (and the player letting the Steward decide routine matters), the Steward picks the first of these options that can be chosen, and it is only reported, not asked.

title: First Contact: the %s
clan_name
text: Our scouts have found the %s, led by %s %s. %s What face do we show them?

options.label: Offer gifts
options.desc: Send 20 food and fine furs. They will think well of us. (+20 relations)
result: The %s accept our gifts. %s nods: "Your people may pass in peace."

options.label: Show our strength
options.desc: Our warriors stand tall at the border. Martial clans respect it; others take it as a threat.
result: %s eyes our warriors. "Strong. Good." The %s will think twice before raiding us.

else_do.reason: you came to us with spears raised

else_result: The %s take our display as a threat and pull back into their lands.

options.label: Keep our distance
options.desc: Watch them, say nothing.
result: We watch the %s from afar, and they watch us.

title: A Messenger from the %s
clan_name
text: A painted runner stops at the edge of the firelight. "%s %s says: give us %d food, or our spears will come and take it."

options.label: Pay
desc: Hand over %d food. No raid for now (+5 relations).
result: The runner leaves with our food. %s is satisfied - for now.

options.label: Refuse
options.desc: Send the runner away. Their war band will come.

do.reason: you sent our messenger away empty-handed

result: The runner spits at our fire and is gone. The %s are coming.

title: The %s Call Us to War
clan_name
text: A runner of our allies the %s arrives breathless: "%s %s asks: will our brothers send spears against the %s?"

options.label: Send a war party
desc: Choose a leader to plan a raid on the %s (+10 with our allies).
result: We will march with the %s against the %s. Choose who leads our spears.

options.label: Send gifts instead
options.desc: 15 food for their warriors; they go alone (+3).
result: The %s raid the %s alone, fed by our food.

options.label: Refuse
options.desc: This is not our fight (-12 with our allies).

do.reason: you left us to fight alone

result: The runner leaves without a word. The %s will remember.

title: The %s After the Battle
clan_name
text: %s %s comes out of the smoke, unarmed. "Enough. The %s will bow to your fire, if you let our children live."

options.label: Accept their submission
options.desc: They become our vassals: 3 food a day, no more raids.
result: %s lays down their weapons at our fire. The %s are ours.

options.label: Demand a heavy tribute
options.desc: 6 food a day - but they will hate us, and may rise again.

do.grudge: you crushed us under a heavy tribute

options.result: They will pay, and they will hate us for it.

options.label: Spare them freely
options.desc: Make peace with no tribute (+20 relations, 20 days of peace).
options.result: We let them go in peace. The tale of our mercy will travel far.

title: The %s After the Battle
clan_name
text: The %s pull back behind their huts, bloodied but still defiant.

options.label: Let them lick their wounds
options.desc: They are beaten, but not yet broken.

discontent._doc: A family whose spirits stay low wants to leave (life.gd, config/life.json 'leave'). Vars: person (their name), who (them, for the actions' who).
discontent.title: A Family Loses Heart
text: The family of %s has lost heart. They sit apart from the fire, work without will and speak of leaving the tribe.

options.label: Sit with them at the fire
options.desc: Hear them out over a shared meal.
result: The family of %s talks with you long into the night. In the morning they take up their work again.

options.label: Honour their family
options.desc: Give them crafted goods and a place of honour at the next feast.

do.remember: was honoured by the chieftain before the whole tribe on Day %d

result: The family of %s stands taller. The tribe sees that every family counts.

options.label: Let them go
options.desc: Every family is free to find its own fire.
result: The family of %s gathers its things and walks away from the tribe.
